Having a spooky October? We have too while working on stability improvements and better error logging for SideStore!

# Changelog
* Remove the buggy retry code finally (@nythepegasus)
* Recompile and update AltBackup to make it function again (@nythepegasus)
* Update submodule dependencies (@naturecodevoid and @nythepegasus)

Having a good September? We have been hard at work on stability improvements and better error logging for SideStore!

# Changes 

 * The Unable to install app (aka staging error) error message has been split into explicit error messages. This should allow people who get the error to troubleshoot more easily. (Dadoum for initial implementation, naturecodevoid for fixes)
* AltSign and all other dependencies were updated. This should help fix some issues. (spidy123222 and Joelle Lonkell for AltSign, naturecodevoided for everything else)
* The notification and alert explaining SideStore needing to be in the background to refresh was shortened and made clearer. (spidy123322)
Full Changelog: https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/compare/0.5.0..0.5.1

Happy July! We have been hard at work on stability improvements for SideStore!

# Changes 

 * [bugfix] Widget now functions properly from Github Actions builds
* [bugfix] Installing and refreshing apps should be much more stable
* [bugfix] Reintroduce notification when refreshing SideStore
* [feature] Add retries to enabling JIT to make it a little more stable
* [feature] Change the default anisette server to be https://ani.sidestore.io/ instead of the 6969 port (which no longer exists)
* [UI] Change the Patreon screen to display our different social media accounts
* [upstream] Fix many deprecation warnings
* [upstream] Fix "Open in.." file dialog not working for SideStore
* [upstream] Fix various UI elements to be more performant/less buggy
Full Changelog: https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/compare/0.4.0..0.5.0

Happy May! We have been very busy with doing quality of life changes and fixing bugs everyone’s been having. WE RECOMMEND FRESH INSTALL ON THIS UPDATE. it took this long as there was some problems that were hard and some things needed fixed before releasing and testing, but this should make sidestore much better to use. If you ever want to test sidestore versions use nightly version of sidestore. If you’re into even more experimental join our discord and try our ipas we ask for testing. 

 For people that want to use MDC no3applimit (MacDirtyCow). It’s currently not ready as it includes the patch not needing any external apps. So for any brave people that really want it you will have to look at this pull request and use the ipa downloads from GitHub actions  https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/259 or get it from our site as a ipa labeled MDC.

 What's Changed: 

 - Fix: Fix expire early issue (it will open safari to finish refreshing sidestore now.) 

 - Updated to Anisette V3, this is much better than version 1 as it prevents locking and other anisette issues. 

 - Fix: no provisioning profile with the requested identifier. 

 - Remove jkcoxson anisette server from preferred servers. 

 - Update store check to check for AltServer or SideServer installation 

 - refactor minimuxer to use swift-bridge (#321) 

 - Change the default anisette server 

 - fix: hopefully reduce ApplicationVerificationFailed errors by removing _CodeSignature folders since those may cause a problems. 

 - Fix: 'The name for this app is invalid' error(#361). 

 - Remove app groups that contain AltStore 

 - Change SideStore Anisette server url to use https. Full Commit Changelog: https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/compare/0.3.1...0.4.0

Happy March! We have been busy with doing quality of life changes and getting stuff up and running like deactivating and getting bugs fixed that you guys found in nightly. We don’t currently have a fix for expiring early issue but is in the works like anisette issues. This should allow basic support for all functions.

 For people that want to use MDC no3applimit (MacDirtyCow). It’s currently not ready as it includes the patch not needing any external apps. So for any brave people that really want it you will have to look at this pull request and use the ipa downloads from GitHub actions  https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/259 . We don’t recommend relying on pull requests as because a commit could break the app so be warned, this is the same for nightly but with nightly has latest develop branch changes.

 What's Changed:

 - Icon change (thanks LittRitt!)

 - Reset pairing file button 

 - Advanced settings button 

 - Browse icon change 

 - Credit adjustment 

 - Background color fixes 

 - Added more permission types for sources 

 - Join Patreon button crash fix 

 - Turned off background notification refreshes 

 - Sidestore Logger

 - Additional logging for minimuxer for sidestore for troubleshooting 

 - Replace Placeholder video for pairing instructions. 

 - Fix BundleId issues on parts of sidestore 

 - Fix trusted sources if one app has problems that it shouldn’t take down the full list.

releases.localizedDescription:
#### This is release for:
  - version: "0.6.4-20260803.1224+5ca7f190"
  - revision: "5ca7f190"
  - timestamp: "Mon Aug  3 14:45:38 2026"

#### What's Changed:
- fix: oops missed renaming stadalone operations's base inheritance which i said would fix later after finalization of design
- rework: make operationContext handle weights(for) call properly in both independent scope and when in consuming scope such as pipeline + cleanup access modifiers, scoping, bases etc
- architecture: keep operations still agnostic of their steps by keeping sub operation types decision within OperationStep.steps() implementation detail.
- notes: added design choice notes for future maintainers on pipeline design (to prevent recursions) on keeping pipeline steps flat
- fix: disambiguate removeDeactivateApp(removeBackup, removeEntry) vs delete(uninstall, removeEntry) flows with clear separation of concerns
- fix: sources view was infinitely loading in the pill for progress indication
- fixes for revoked cert checks to strictly check installed app on refresh path
- refactor: move pipeline executions into PipelineExecutor
- fixed all verifyCertificateOperation issues by tightly and thoroughly reviewing the flow
- signing: fix all (per app) custom cert signing related issues
- fix: unnecessary anisette data fetch was not required when skipProvisioning is true - leave existing anisette untouched in session
- submodules: updated to latest
- diag: added logging to notify cert mismatch even if usable
- fix: operations logging was not enforcing developer settings
- diag: print user settings changes as debugLog - pretty print as json
- fix: make storageExplorer view lazy and use caching to not be eager and make ui sluggish
- diag: added more logging + added toggle to switch sidestore verbose logging
- move things around + remove menu icons
- refactor: break down storageExplorer view into distinct files
- fix: storage explorer was choppy during back nav - coz of nav graph not handled properly when coming from UIKit, and the task/bgTask wasn't properly canceled
- developer-options: gate import/export account raw-json behind #DEBUG
- fix: remove extra space below the diagnostics section
- fix + cleanup: move certificates access in keychain into Keychain class - separation of concerns + fix compile issues
- fix compile issues (we now good!)
- optimization: setActiveCertificate already handles certificate validation, so when we cache we cache it and other formats of it at once, so one can always get them as a single unit from cache instead of doing get + decrypt eacht time
- checkpoint-2: review completed for these files and we good with the changes (i have manually reviewed all so if any would be compile errors which I will fix in next run)
- cleanup: remove old account backup/restore stuff from settings which now live in Backup & Restore subview
- cleanup: reflect on recent altcertificate api changes
- rename user customization flags to be meaningful
- checkpoint-1: review completed for these files and we good with the changes (now we use CertificateStore to access AltCertificate enc/dec operations, ImportedAccount needs to be versioned and encrypted using AES GCM)
- cleanup: refine cert holder in keychain to be properly throwing than eating up exceptions and storing as nil for AltCertificate?
- fix: remove ambiguity of unencrypted vs encrypted with "" by defining API names properly and using proper overloads!
- fix: removed the deadly (non-deterministic) fallback behavior trying all combo ex: password -> nil -> "", when trying to decrypt
- bug-fix: was using sideconf pass as cert store password instead of using actual p12 password lol
- move export account dialog into own vc
- added missed file in pbxproj

 - refactor minimuxer to use swift-bridge (#321) 

 - Change the default anisette server 

 - fix: hopefully reduce ApplicationVerificationFailed errors by removing _CodeSignature folders since those may cause a problems. 

 - Fix: 'The name for this app is invalid' error(#361). 

 - Remove app groups that contain AltStore 

 - Change SideStore Anisette server url to use https. Full Commit Changelog: https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/compare/0.3.1...0.4.0

Happy March! We have been busy with doing quality of life changes and getting stuff up and running like deactivating and getting bugs fixed that you guys found in nightly. We don’t currently have a fix for expiring early issue but is in the works like anisette issues. This should allow basic support for all functions.

 For people that want to use MDC no3applimit (MacDirtyCow). It’s currently not ready as it includes the patch not needing any external apps. So for any brave people that really want it you will have to look at this pull request and use the ipa downloads from GitHub actions  https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/pull/259 . We don’t recommend relying on pull requests as because a commit could break the app so be warned, this is the same for nightly but with nightly has latest develop branch changes.

 What's Changed: 

 - Fix beta apps not refreshing 

 - Fix beta apps on the my apps view 

 - Fix deactivating/activating apps 

 - Merge all of Riley's new error handling stuff 

 - add easy anisette server selector iOS Settings app 

 - added toggle for custom anisette server 

 - Change the default anisette server 

 - Add a bit more logging throughout the signing process to help us pin down issues 

 - Allow for .mobiledevicepairing and .plist files to be selected, try and pin down why users can't select either 

 - Hopefully fix AltWidget issues 

 - Add analytics to help developers understand current demographic of users (and hopefully pin down version specific bugs) 

 - Icon change (thanks LittRitt!) 

 - Sidestore directory accessible in files 

 - Reset pairing file button 

 - Advanced settings button 

 - Browse icon change 

 - Credit adjustment 

 - Background color fixes 

 - Added more permission types for sources 

 - Join Patreon button crash fix 

 - Turned off background notification refreshes 

 - Sidestore Logger 

 - Minimuxer logger 

 - Additional logging for minimuxer for sidestore for troubleshooting 

 - Replace Placeholder video for pairing instructions. 

 - Fix BundleId issues on parts of sidestore 

 - Fix trusted sources if one app has problems that it shouldn’t take down the full list. 

 

 Full Commit Changelog: https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/compare/0.1.1...0.3.1
